name: RCSB_get_chemical_component
description: Get detailed chemical component information from the RCSB Protein Data Bank by 3-letter component ID. Returns the chemical name, formula, molecular weight, type (non-polymer, peptide-like, D-saccharide, etc.), InChI/SMILES descriptors, and synonyms. Chemical components include ligands, drugs, cofactors, and modified residues found in PDB structures. Common examples: ATP, HEM (heme), NAG (N-acetylglucosamine), STI (imatinib/Gleevec), FAD, NAD.

oneOf.description: Chemical component details from RCSB PDB

formula.description: Molecular formula (e.g., 'C10 H16 N5 O13 P3')

type.description: Component type (non-polymer, peptide-like, D-saccharide, L-peptide linking, etc.)

pdbx_ambiguous_flag.description: 'Y' when the component's identity or geometry is ambiguous in the entries that use it, 'N' when not.

pdbx_initial_date.description: When the component was first defined, e.g. '1999-07-08T00:00:00.000+00:00'.

pdbx_modified_date.description: When its definition last changed, e.g. '2011-06-04...'. Chemical component definitions are revised, which can change atom names between releases.

pdbx_processing_site.description: Which wwPDB site processed it, e.g. 'EBI', 'RCSB', 'PDBj'.

pdbx_chem_comp_descriptor.description: Chemical descriptors including InChI, InChIKey, SMILES (canonical and isomeric)

program_version.description: Version of the program that generated the identifier, e.g. '10.04'. InChI and SMILES differ between generator versions, so a string comparison across versions can fail on the same molecule.

pdbx_chem_comp_audit.description: The definition's change history, each with an action_type such as 'Create component'. What changed and when.

rcsb_chem_comp_container_identifiers.description: Cross-references for the component - comp_id, drugbank_id and rcsb_id. The join to DrugBank, which is how a ligand is matched to a drug.

rcsb_chem_comp_descriptor.description: Canonical descriptors - InChI, InChIKey, SMILES and the stereo-aware SMILES. The machine-readable structure.

rcsb_chem_comp_info.description: Atom and bond counts including the chiral and aromatic breakdowns. What says whether the component has stereochemistry at all.

rcsb_chem_comp_related.description: Related components, each with its comp_id and the resource relating them - 6 for ATP. Analogues and parent compounds, which is how a modified nucleotide is traced to its parent.

rcsb_chem_comp_synonyms.description: Other names for the component, each with its provenance - 9 for ATP.

rcsb_chem_comp_target.description: Proteins the component is known to target, each with its interaction type - 43 for ATP. The pharmacology attached to the ligand definition itself.

rcsb_id.description: The component's PDB chemical id, e.g. 'ATP'.
